messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: customer MapleFin (Private VPC) - elevated 5xx and model fetch timeouts from ALB -> backend. Paging Mike (oncall). https://redwood.incidents/1857504321 :rotating_light:
Mike (oncall): I'm on call. grabbing logs and paging infra + cs. ETA 2m.
Emily (SRE): seeing spike in 502/504 from the private ALB to the model pool. Errors look like TLS connect timeout to model-hub.maplefin.internal:443. sample from runtime node: ```curl -v https://model-hub.maplefin.internal/ping --connect-timeout 5
* Connected to model-hub.maplefin.internal (10.12.34.56) port 443 (#0)
* connect timed out
* Failed to connect to model-hub.maplefin.internal port 443: Operation timed out
```
Andrew (Infra): checking VPC flow logs and security groups now. quick note: customer uses ALB in front of our edge NATs, backend egress to model-hub is via customer-managed SGs/NACLs.
Natalie (Product): impact: MapleFin prod traffic hitting Redwood Private dedicated pool -> visible failures for all their sessions. CS is already on the phone.
Raj (CS): Jess (MapleFin) on the line says they deployed a security hardening change ~15m ago. waiting for confirmation. customer is asking for ETA.
Sam (Security): If we need to open anything temporarily, we require explicit IPs/CIDRs and an audit log entry. don't want open egress wide.
Jess (MapleFin): Confirmed - we pushed a script to tighten outbound rules and removed allowed cidrs for unknown endpoints. Rolling back now if required. investigating which rule removed 443 to 35.201.0.0/16 (redwood-managed egress).
Emily (SRE): OK, mitigation plan: 1) If customer can rollback, that's quickest. 2) If not possible immediately, Redwood can add a cross-account SG exception at the ALB/NAT layer to allow egress to our model-hosting egress CIDRs for MapleFin's dedicated pool only. Prefer SG change over broad NACL changes. 3) Also prepare a fallback: route a small percentage of traffic to hosted fallback model via routing policy.
Mike (oncall): Jess, can you confirm rollback? if not, Andrew please prep temporary SG rule and I'll coordinate with Sam for approval.
Jess (MapleFin): Rolling back now. I'll ping when complete.
Andrew (Infra): Preparing SG change. proposed aws cli (to be run by customer or with their auth): ```aws ec2 authorize-security-group-egress --group-id sg-0abc123def456 --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 35.201.0.0/16 --description "Allow Redwood model egress temporarily"``` If customer wants us to apply, we need IAM-approved runbook and they need to add us to their runbook.
Sam (Security): I approve the temporary rule provided it's limited to the two egress CIDRs: 35.201.0.0/16 and 34.120.0.0/16, and expires in 45 minutes. Please log change to our audit tracker: https://redwood.sec/audit.
Mike (oncall): Andrew - apply and test once Jess confirms they can't roll back. I'll stand by.
Jess (MapleFin): rollback completed at 1857504600. verifying...
Emily (SRE): running quick checks from runtime after Jess rollback: ```curl -v https://model-hub.maplefin.internal/ping --connect-timeout 5
* Connected to model-hub.maplefin.internal (10.12.34.56) port 443 (#0)
* TLS handshake completed
* HTTP/1.1 200 OK
``` Looks good from our runtime.
Raj (CS): Customer confirms UX restored. they see successful calls.:+1:
Natalie (Product): Can we still enable fallback routing for 5% as a safety net? will monitor quality.
Emily (SRE): I'll roll a 5% canary route to hosted fallback for 30m and watch error delta. config snippet: ```routes: - name: maplefin-canary fallback: hosted-model weight: 5% duration: 30m```
Mike (oncall): Setting handoff: I'll continue watch for 30m then handoff to Andrew for postmortem and rollback verification. ETA handoff 00:30.
Sam (Security): Note for postmortem: capture what change in customer hardening removed the egress rule, add recommended guardrail doc (pre-approved outbound cidrs for model egress).
Jess (MapleFin): Thanks all - we reverted the hardening change. we'll add the explicit Redwood egress list to our terraform to avoid future breakage. will share PR link.
Emily (SRE): Observability: error rate back to baseline, latency normalized. Canary to hosted shows no regression.
Mike (oncall): Closing incident channel in 30m after final verification. great cross-team fast response. :tada:
Incident Bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: MapleFin network egress restored and canary stable. Root cause flagged: customer hardening removed required egress CIDR -> follow-up: postmortem + runbook updates. Incident closed at 1857505321.
